verdict.rationale: Keycloak ships its own hosted sign-in and sign-up flows: it documents self-registration, forgot-password, terms acceptance, progressive profiling and internationalization. An Account Console lets users update their profile, change passwords, set up 2FA and link identity providers. Themes customize the look and feel of these pages. Community reports confirm production use of the hosted login page but note front-end rough edges: expired login-page tokens cause errors, and multiple tabs can lose the redirect. missing for 10: in-depth evidence of how far theme customization goes (only headings are cited), no embeddable prebuilt UI components for app frameworks, and independent corroboration that the hosted pages work smoothly in production.
